usage: The word '毛' (mou4) refers to the fur or hair on animals or sometimes on humans.
'毛' is primarily a noun and can be used to describe the animal's body parts related to its fur.
It can appear in simple phrases to specify the type or condition of the fur, such as 'short fur' or 'thick fur.'
This word is often combined with adjectives to describe texture, color, or length of fur.
In everyday usage, '毛' can also mean hair outside of the animal context, for example, 'body hair.'
